Now and next

Your client is already looking for you on the phone

Now

  • Instagram @baldininitashkent and a page in the Tashkent City Mall directory: no website of its own.
  • People ask for price, size and stock in messages and wait for a reply.
  • A search for “Baldinini” shows marketplaces first: Ozon lists thousands of third-party offers under the name.

With the store

  • Your own store with the season’s collection, UZS prices and size availability in the boutique.
  • A story link opens the product page straight away: size, try-on, order.
  • The original from the Tashkent City boutique, with try-on and a consultant, at your own address.

Who buys

The Baldinini client in Tashkent

The store is built around four habits. Floor neighbours (Cole Haan, Ecco, Vitacci) sell comfort; Baldinini sells an Italian pair that is comfortable and gets noticed.

Arrives from Instagram

Browses on the phone between other things. Price and their size must be visible at once, without messaging.

Tries on first

An expensive pair is bought after trying it on. Hence a boutique booking and a courier who waits during the try-on.

Pays for the original

Italy, leather inside, the current season from the official boutique rather than an unknown seller’s listing.

Expects quiet service

A consultant, a box with a card, private prices for regulars. No loud discounts in the window.

The store

The client journey: tap a step

On the right is the real store from the mockup. Walk the whole journey: pick a size, book a try-on, place and pay for an order. Then open the panel below: the order and the booking are already there.

Store full screen

How luxury sells online

Eight techniques from Italy, the US and Europe

We looked at how Baldinini, Santoni, Tod’s, Ferragamo, Furla, Saks, Neiman Marcus, Nordstrom, Stuart Weitzman, Mytheresa, LuisaViaRoma, Net-a-Porter and Bally sell. What they share: a calm shop window, large photos, no discount race. This is what went into the store.

Try-on by appointment

Pick a model and size; the pair is set aside for the visit.

A consultant in chat

Advises on fit and sends photos on foot.

Seen at: Net-a-Porter, Saks, Neiman Marcus

Private sales

Special prices for regulars only; the window stays calm.

Seen at: Baldinini Eternity Club, Mytheresa

Box and card

The gift is wrapped and signed with your words.

Seen at: Mytheresa, Net-a-Porter, Nordstrom

Size guide

The brand chart in EU, US, UK and a foot-length check.

Seen at: Baldinini, Mytheresa

“My size is back”

Size out of stock: the client leaves a number and hears first.

Seen at: Mytheresa, Net-a-Porter

Complete the look

A bag and belt to match the pair, in one tap.

Seen at: Baldinini, Mytheresa, Saks

Delivery with try-on

The courier waits during the try-on and takes back what doesn’t fit.

Seen at: the local version of free returns at Nordstrom and Mytheresa

Made in Italy

Since 1910, San Mauro Pascoli

In the store the brand’s story is told with facts from the official Baldinini site: a family workshop, hand stitching, Made in Italy on every model of the season. No big words: luxury is recognised by its calm.

The store font is Jost, a free typeface close in form to their Futura PT. Colours come from their site: black, white, grey #858585 and the sand #d8aa8a that underlines links on their banners.
